name: Salvation
source:
You and your companion foolishly stumbled into the deep dark den ruined by an earthquake. The both of you decided on this exploration in search of an ancient history. Your fears heighten as you traverse the small tunnels, unable to find anything for a long time. However, be not afraid as God 's grace can penetrate even the darkest corners of the world. We pray for your salvation, guided by our Messiah.

[From [url=https://nucluus.itch.io/salvation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和你的同伴愚蠢地跌进了被地震毁坏的深邃黑暗的巢穴。你们俩决定进行这次探索，寻找古老的历史。当你穿过小隧道时，你的恐惧感加剧，很长一段时间都找不到任何东西。然而，不要害怕，因为上帝的恩典甚至可以渗透到世界上最黑暗的角落。我们为你的救赎祈祷，在我们的弥赛亚的指导下。

[来自[url=https://nucluus.itch.io/salvation]itch.io[/url]]
